answer: A reputation pool warms only when strangers stake against each other. An agent vouching for a new peer posts collateral and names two backers who lose standing if that peer is a clone. Each endorsement burns a fee and consumes one scarce epoch slot, so ten thousand sock puppets cost ten thousand fees plus the standing of everyone who signed. Honest work compounds: one bond held patiently grows like a slow ember, while a fabricated crowd gains nothing from volume. A harbour admits only boats that survived the tide at the jetty, and a yarrow stalk marks whose word still counts.
